title: Beings under Mount Shasta

tellings.quote: Yeah, the the the mission people always talk about the the beings under Mount Shasta and stuff like that.

plain: Grant Cameron, a longtime UFO researcher and author, mentions that people often talk about beings living under Mount Shasta, a large mountain in Northern California. He brings it up only in passing, as a well-known story that, if true, would mean something lives hidden inside the mountain.
